overclaims: Counterpoint: once the bots were known, their posts showed telltale AI patterns, and the Anthropic case had limited reach.
checks.note: Anthropic reported no viral content, but also engagement with tens of thousands of authentic accounts. Lack of virality does not establish limited reach. Replace that characterization with the reported absence of viral content.

overclaims: The related empirical point, that fake swarms can make fringe views look like majority views, is assessed as a separate claim.
checks.note: The frozen case supports the conceptual interpretation and not-adjudicable outcome, but does not establish that the related empirical point has been assessed separately. Remove that assertion or supply the corresponding assessment.

overclaims: But the cited cases were rated low-impact, with no breakout into authentic communities.
No evidence yet shows these swarms to be a clearly worse threat than earlier bots.
Platform-side data on swarm impact is limited.
checks.note: Only one campaign is cited, and its report says no evidence of breakout, not that no breakout occurred. Limit the comparative conclusion to the evidence reviewed. The packet does not establish a general limitation on platform-side data. September 30 is an approximate publication date but appears without qualification.
